Hi Ana —

Appreciate the snapshot. Quick read-through and a few clarifying Qs from our side before we propose the shortlist:

- For the small subset (6–8k tokens), are those single long documents per request or concatenations of search + context?
- Do the end-of-day reports originate from one automated job (can be batched) or from many interactive users triggering exports?

Initial thinking (very rough):
- Interactive search / short summarization: Redwood-std-7B-q8 (low latency, good for higher concurrency)
- Long-compression & extraction workflows: Redwood-13B-q5 or a 13B-16k context variant to avoid repeated chunking for the 6–8k cases
- Bulk rerank / batch: leverage CPU-based reranker or small dedicated 7B pool for throughput economics

I'll pull a concise model-shortlist matrix and estimated token runway for Wednesday's call. Vivek — can you advise on whether Dedicated burst capacity makes sense for the reported spikes?

Thanks,
Mina

Mina — quick notes from infra/opinion:

- Spikes to 240 concurrent: if those are short-lived (under 5–10m) we should use Hosted with autoscaling + burst credits for first 90 days; Dedicated reserved pool only if sustained >120 concurrent for >30m windows.
- For 6–8k single-request contexts, a 16k-context 13B quantized option reduces tokenization and chunking overhead — cheaper at the end-to-end app level despite higher per-token cost.
- Suggest adding token prefix caching for repeated patient metadata across requests — could drop effective tokens by ~15–25%.

I've sketched a cost run-rate for the three model tiers and put the link in the drive. Also included an ops checklist for warm-up and KV cache priming.

Vivek

Ana — attaching the onboarding playbook you requested and a short token runway projection. Highlights below:

Summary recommendations (one-pager):
- Short interactive flows (<=1.5k tokens): Redwood-std-7B-q8 — target p95 latency <300ms using 4-instance autoscale policy.
- Mid-length (1.5k–6k): Redwood-13B-q5-16k — best tradeoff for fewer chunks and higher extract accuracy.
- Long single-request (6k–8k): Redwood-13B-16k or a hybrid pipeline (13B compress then 7B summarize) depending on tolerance for a 2–3x cost delta.

Token runway (first 6 mo) — conservative estimate for current usage profile:
- Month 1: 45M tokens (ramp + initial integrations)
- Month 3: 110M tokens (steady-state + early growth)
- Month 6: 260M tokens (full product rollouts at multiple customers)

Ops checklist (concise):
- Enable prefix KV caching for patient metadata.
- Configure job-level debounce: 90s for scheduled exports (reduces duplicate fetches).
- Warm-up Dedicated instances with representative sequences before cutover.
- Enable fallback model policy: if 13B pool saturated, route to 7B with reduced context + best-effort summarization.

Attachments: onboarding_playbook_v1.docx (includes model_shortlist_matrix.pdf embedded + worksheets).

I'll schedule a 30-min follow-up to walk through the playbook and the cost tradeoffs; Grace and Priyom will join to cover CS handoff and integration checklist.

Cheers,
Mina
